description: This file contains functions for platform-specific upgrade procedures for a device running OpenWrt on Rockchip ARMv8 platform, including image verification, copying configuration, and performing upgrades.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the integrity and layout of the upgrade image, compares partition tables, and determines if a full image write is necessary.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to the target partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process, including image validation, partition comparisons, flashing the image to device partitions, and updating UUIDs.
